elements.before: Independent, lender-grade analysis for grocery stores and supermarkets across SBA 7(a) and 504, USDA rural, conventional bank and asset-based, CDFI and HFFI food-access, and going-concern acquisition capital. This page is our standing read on why the razor-thin net margin makes debt service fragile, how grocery feasibility forecasts fail review, and the difference between the market study, the feasibility study, and the going-concern appraisal a lender requires.
elements.after: A grocery store feasibility study has to begin with the competition. Aldi ended 2025 with 2,614 US stores and is still adding more,7 and a new discounter in the trade area is the largest outside risk to an independent's sales. Feasibility Study Company prepares these studies for grocery and supermarket owners, developers and their lenders, with a market study that maps every competing opening. Because net margins are razor-thin, the study stress-tests sales, shrink and the wholesaler lien, then sizes debt for bank and asset-based lenders, SBA 7(a) and 504, USDA rural programs and CDFI or HFFI food-access funds.
